profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary: Full-stack web developer with 25+ years of hands-on ColdFusion and SQL Server experience, starting with ColdFusion e-commerce work in 2000, building, maintaining and debugging business-critical web applications. Currently running ColdFusion 2023 on Windows Server in Azure, with strong T-SQL, JavaScript/jQuery and RESTful API integration skills. Known for improving performance, tightening security and delivering projects from requirements through deployment.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Maintain, debug and enhance ColdFusion web applications on ColdFusion 2023, hosted on Windows Server in Azure, backed by SQL Server databases
•	Recently adopted AI-assisted development with Claude Code to speed up coding, debugging and code review
•	Improved performance on several websites using ColdFusion, SQL Server, JavaScript and jQuery
•	Designed a mobile app and engineered the secure RESTful API web services that support it
•	Implemented a SAML single sign-on application using Component Space SAML and ASP.NET, automating a client's manual processes
•	Implemented security standards to prevent cross-site scripting and SQL injection attacks
•	Designed and built several responsive websites with HTML5 and CSS3 for a better user experience
positions.insights: Skills: ColdFusion · SQL Server · T-SQL · JavaScript · jQuery · CSS · HTML · Project Management · jQuery UI · Claude Code · Claude Skills

positions.title: ColdFusion Administrator
positions.description:
Moved ColdFusion website from ColdFusion 4.5 environment to ColdFusion 9.
Setup SQL Server 2005 Database Server as ColdFusion backend.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Streamlined order fulfillment by building applications that integrate United Parcel Service (UPS) APIs using ColdFusion and SQL
•	Improved the online shopping experience by enhancing product detail pages and the checkout process with ColdFusion and jQuery
•	Reduced programming time and website update time for the site manager by building Content Management System enhancements

positions.title: Lead Rich Internet Application Developer
positions.description:
•	Secured a high-profile client by building a Dynamic Financial Portfolio Reporting Interface to their specifications, and delivered a Dashboard giving users quick access to key data (Flex, ActionScript, ColdFusion)
•	Upgraded website security with JavaScript and ColdFusion to meet the strict standards of several major financial institutions
•	Optimized ColdFusion code and SQL stored procedure performance, and resolved 60+ bugs while tracking and communicating progress with users

positions.title: Programmer Analyst
positions.description:
•	Managed projects end to end, from requirements and technical specifications through development, testing and deployment
•	Built an application-driven intranet that increased staff productivity and a Hierarchical Commission Report (ColdFusion, SQL stored procedures) that reduced calls to Customer Service
•	Upgraded websites to PCI standards, monitored performance and reliability, and trained and supervised new developers and users

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
•	Edited, debugged and maintained the company's public ColdFusion e-commerce website, fixing issues and keeping the site running reliably for online shoppers
•	Advanced from entry-level to Programmer Analyst within months through self-education

positions.title: Internet Sales Specialist
positions.description:
Developed copy and produced images for website and Direct Mail catalog using Adobe Photoshop
Assisted in development of "look and feel" consistent with Direct Mail catalog campaign to channel existing customers on-line, establish brand presence, and mine data
Contributed new concepts for website features and navigational tools to enhance ease of use and promote customer interaction
Supervised telemarketing call center - fielding sales and customer service calls, customer support, resolving sales and customer service issues, employee training and mentoring
